name: Aquarium
title: aquaverse.im
payoff: Buy and add fish to your aquarium!
shortDescription: Aquarium is a unique platform that allows users to purchase virtual fish and add them to an online aquarium. It's designed for enthusiasts of virtual pets and those interested in interactive digital ecosystems. Users can sign in using Google, making it easily accessible. An example use case is a user looking to relax by managing a virtual aquarium, where they can see their collection grow and participate in a leaderboard.
cons: Potential privacy concerns with Google sign-in
